name: DerpAsso
source:
You're Maxime Penchant, a student in a university. Well, you're going to fail your year.
Since the school is somewhat expensive, it would be a shame.

But your teacher is going to give you one chance: enter a club of the school to complete your module and the year.

By the way, it's also the moment to get a girlfriend since your club will be — obviously, it's so convenient — filled with girls!

Good luck.

PS: Be on your guard, just because it's only a school, it doesn't mean that you can't die.
